title: The 1988 Toyota Supra 7M-GE: A Three-Year Engine Saga
summary: This videos charts a dramatic, multi‑year repair saga of a 1988 Toyota Supra with the notoriously fragile 7M-GE engine. The shop narrates a relentless sequence of hurdles—from seized brakes and a misfiring engine to a crushed cylinder block and a failed machine-shop partnership—culminating in a donor‑engine salvage plan and a painstaking in‑house rebuild. Interwoven with a shift in momentum, the story culminates in a completed car, a relieved owner, and a heartfelt tribute to a skilled machinist who helped along the way, illustrating resilience and problem‑solving under pressure in a specialization-focused shop setting.
topics: oil leaks and rear main seal

sections.title: Intro and initial diagnosis
sections.description: The video opens with the car described as the most challenging the shop has faced, having sat for over three years and presenting a misfiring engine and seized brakes. The host frames the project as a test of perseverance and sets up the narrative arc toward completion.

sections.title: Disassembly reveals cylinder and block issues
sections.description: After removing the cylinder head, boroscope inspection exposes severe cylinder damage and a compromised block, raising serious questions about whether the engine can be saved or must be replaced.

sections.title: Machine-shop hurdles and salvage planning
concepts: search for a viable build shop and alternatives
sections.description: The team discovers that sourcing and repairing a 7MGE block is difficult and risky, with many shops unwilling to warranty work. This section documents the decision context and the search for a salvage path, foreshadowing donor-engine considerations.

sections.title: Donor-engine planning and in-house salvage effort
concepts: exploration of donor options and 2JZ considerations
sections.description: With limited confidence in restoring the original 7MGE, the shop debates donor-engine routes, notes the machining mismatch that caused a rework, and outlines the plan to salvage via an in-house teardown and a donor engine strategy.

sections.title: Resolution, test drive, and emotional closure
sections.description: Despite numerous setbacks, the car reaches a functional state and undergoes a test drive. The owner's emotional response and a tribute to the late machinist John underscore the project’s human and educational weight—perseverance, problem‑solving, and craftsmanship in practice.

sections.title: Closing reflections
sections.description: The host closes with a reflection on perseverance and pride in craft, emphasizing that problem‑solving and resilience are central to any skilled trade.
